items.title: Josephine Davies interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 14, 2025
items.q: I went to Guildhall... someone had “A Love Supreme,” John Coltrane and I heard that and I thought well that sounds like freedom to me... I switched to the jazz course

ctx.x: I’m going to guess that perhaps you do not take advantage of the technology that enables us now to get rid of a stray note. Or, “Oh the bass hit this just before the bass drum, let’s move the note.”

I would say that’s a very fair comment. Yes. I don’t necessarily take advantage of all the technology. In some ways maybe I could do more of that but in other ways I think whatever happens on the day happens on the day and that’s what people get. I always think that we as musicians are so overcritical of what happens, our own playing primarily, and we can get really caught up in knots that that could have been better. And the technology allows us to make changes that we wouldn’t otherwise be able to. And there’s…
